question: By what designation is this entire practice identified when addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The practice is referred to as all this.
The goddess is addressed as fair-faced.
The practice bears the designation Makaradhvaja.
inference: This entire practice is designated by the name Makaradhvaja.
plain_english: But all this, O fair-faced one, is known by the name Makaradhvaja.
